3 Days Amboseli Safari

Package overview

Experience the breathtaking wilderness of , renowned for its majestic herds of elephants, stunning views of , and rich wildlife diversity. This 3-day safari with Magical Africa Safaris (MAS) immerses you in vast open plains, swampy wetlands, acacia woodlands, and unforgettable game drives in one of Kenya’s most iconic parks. Expect sightings of elephants, lions, cheetahs, buffalos, zebras, giraffes, hyenas, and hundreds of bird species.

  • Amboseli National Park
  • Kilimanjaro Views: Capture the iconic photo of the snow-capped mountain rising above the dusty plains, especially at sunrise.
  • Large Elephant Herds: Amboseli is famous for some of the largest elephant herds in Africa, offering incredible opportunities for up-close viewing.
  • Swamp Visits: Watch elephants, hippos, and buffalo congregating around the park's permanent marshlands.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi – Amboseli National Park

Pick up from your hotel/airport in Nairobi by Magical Africa Safaris (MAS) driver-guide. Begin your scenic drive to Amboseli, passing through the beautiful Kenyan countryside. Arrive at the lodge/camp in time for lunch and check-in. Afternoon game drive where you encounter elephants, giraffes, zebras, and possibly predators. Weather permitting, enjoy your first glimpse of Mt. Kilimanjaro towering above the plains. Dinner and overnight at Amboseli (preferred lodge/camp as per your booking).

02Day 2 | Full Day in Amboseli

After breakfast, enjoy a full day dedicated to game viewing. Visit the swamp areas where elephants gather—excellent for photography. Explore different parts of the park, including Observation Hill for panoramic views. Picnic lunch or lunch at the lodge depending on your preference. Continue searching for lions, cheetahs, hyenas, hippos, and abundant birdlife. Dinner and overnight at your Amboseli lodge/camp.

03Day 3 | Amboseli – Nairobi

Enjoy a relaxed morning game drive as you exit the park. Capture final views of wildlife and Mt. Kilimanjaro. Drive back to Nairobi, arriving in the afternoon. Drop-off at your hotel or airport— end of your Magical Africa Safaris (MAS) adventure . Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

What's included

  • Game drives in custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides
  • Pick-up and drop-off from hotel/airport

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
